session_note: Cloud-agent session on branch claude/ecc2k-130-quasi-subfield-poly-nhcj1f, 2026-09-16, on user instruction 'Investigation into quasi-subfield polynomial line for ecc2k 130 alternatives for index calculus'. Before this freeze the corpus cited the quasi-subfield paper only by recollection (GOAL-ECDLP-001 next_action lists 'Huang-Kosters-Yang-Yeo' as a screened family; ledger records cite the sibling CRYPTO 2015 paper KN-LIT-7604 from its abstract). Under core rule 9 a recalled reference supports nothing, so the paper was fetched and read in full so that every claim attributed to it below cites frozen bytes.

attempts.purpose: Publisher's version-of-record PDF (Crossref link for DOI 10.1515/jmc-2015-0049)
attempts.method: curl -sS -L -D headers -o file (session shell), twice: default UA and a Chrome UA string
attempts.reason: The publisher returned HTTP 202 with an empty body on every attempt (also on the /html endpoint and on the legacy degruyter.com host), consistent with a JavaScript bot challenge. Not retried with a browser; the same bytes are served by the author's institutional repository under the same CC BY licence, below.
